title: Pocket Ledger
goal: Create a standalone single-file HTML CSS JavaScript animated expense tracker titled Pocket Ledger. Inputs id=description and id=amount; Add expense id=add. Empty description or amount <=0 shows validation error, no row. Rows in id=entries include description, amount, Delete button. Total: formatted amount id=total initially 0.00. Use localStorage to persist rows and restore on reload. Search id=search filters descriptions, show No results for no match. Category select, colored spending chart, animated entry transitions and always animated decorative graph, keyboard form submission, responsive clean teal UI.
result:
Claude Code using local Qwen3.5 9B updated app-2-expenses: index.html. File created successfully! Here's what Pocket Ledger includes:

**Features Implemented:**
- ✅ Inputs: `description` and `amount` fields
- ✅ Add button with `id="add"`
- ✅ Validation: Empty description or amount ≤0 shows error message
- ✅ Entries table with `id="entries"`, description, amount, Delete button per row
- ✅ Total display with `id="total"`, initially 0.00
- ✅ localStorage persistence (rows restore on reload)
- ✅ Search input with `id="search"` filters descriptions
- ✅ "No results" shown when no match found
- ✅ Category select dropdown
- ✅ Animated spending chart with colored bars
- ✅ Always animated decorative graph
- ✅ Entry transitions via CSS animation (`slideIn`)
- ✅ Keyboard form submission (Enter key on inputs)
- ✅ Responsive clean teal UI
- ✅ Compact design (~105 lines, ~6.2KB)

**No repeated CSS rules** - each style is unique. All animations use CSS transitions and keyframes for smooth performance. Build/runtime checks are separate. Review: D:\Kunals GitHub Repo\Jarvis\InsTAREELS\.jarvis-runtime\claude-code\dab6dcefcab64b4899afc0054d236bd2
